definitions.gloss: to advance; to move forward; to make progress
definitions.explanation: To move forward physically, or to make progress toward a goal. Used for both literal movement and figurative advancement of plans, negotiations, or projects.

examples.japanese: {軍|ぐん}が{前進|ぜんしん}した。
{交渉|こうしょう}が{一歩|いっぽ}{前進|ぜんしん}した。
examples.english: The negotiations moved one step forward.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて{計画|けいかく}は{大|おお}きく{前進|ぜんしん}した。
examples.english: Overcoming difficulties, the plan made great progress.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both physical forward movement (troops, vehicles) and figurative progress (negotiations, research, plans). Often appears in news and formal contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一歩|いっぽ}{前進|ぜんしん}する (to take one step forward)
- {大|おお}きく{前進|ぜんしん}する (to make great progress)
- {着実|ちゃくじつ}に{前進|ぜんしん}する (to advance steadily)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進|すす}む: to advance, to go forward — general-purpose verb for moving ahead
- {後退|こうたい}する: to retreat, to recede — the opposite of {前進|ぜんしん}する
